title: Parkside Investments LLC Sells 1,750 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:

Parkside Investments LLC lowered its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 9.5% in the 3rd quarter, HoldingsChannel.com reports. The institutional investor owned 16,614 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 1,750 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for about 1.8% of Parkside Investments LLC’s holdings, making the stock its 10th biggest holding. Parkside Investments LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $3,750,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also recently made changes to their positions in the business. Moller Financial Services purchased a new stake in Apple during the 3rd quarter valued at $226,000. Peavine Capital LLC boosted its position in Apple by 4.2% during the 3rd quarter. Peavine Capital LLC now owns 7,260 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,639,000 after buying an additional 292 shares during the period. MERIAN GLOBAL INVESTORS UK Ltd boosted its position in Apple by 3.5% during the 3rd quarter. MERIAN GLOBAL INVESTORS UK Ltd now owns 1,061,659 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $239,658,000 after buying an additional 36,321 shares during the period. Intercontinental Wealth Advisors LLC boosted its position in Apple by 13.6% during the 3rd quarter. Intercontinental Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 9,398 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,122,000 after buying an additional 1,128 shares during the period. Finally, Willow Creek Wealth Management Inc. boosted its position in Apple by 12.3% during the 3rd quarter. Willow Creek Wealth Management Inc. now owns 13,167 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,972,000 after buying an additional 1,444 shares during the period. 57.04% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available at this hyperlink . Company insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.
AAPL has been the subject of several analyst reports. DA Davidson dropped their price target on shares of Apple to $260.00 and set a “buy” rating for the company in a research report on Thursday, January 3rd. Robert W. Baird dropped their price target on shares of Apple from $230.00 to $185.00 and set an “outperform” rating for the company in a research report on Thursday, January 3rd. Citigroup dropped their price target on shares of Apple from $265.00 to $240.00 and set a “buy” rating for the company in a research report on Friday, November 2nd. ValuEngine cut shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “sell” rating in a research report on Friday, January 4th. Finally, Bank of America reissued a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, October 9th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-six have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company’s stock. The company currently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $195.19.
Shares of NASDAQ AAPL opened at $154.94 on Thursday. Apple Inc. has a 1 year low of $142.00 and a 1 year high of $233.47. The stock has a market cap of $752.36 billion, a P/E ratio of 13.01, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.45 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a current ratio of 1.12 and a quick ratio of 1.09.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $61.55 billion. During the same period last year, the company posted $2.07 EPS. Apple’s revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. As a group, research analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 12.1 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
